nodes.title: Lincoln Park photos
nodes.content:
# One row per photo of the collection, with the links a Simple View shows.
return curio_load_collection("data.curio.mapillary-sample")
nodes.goal: Load the Lincoln Park street photos collection: one row per photo, with its thumbnail and its full photo in image_url.

nodes.title: Survey photos
nodes.content:
import pandas as pd

# The street survey's photos, as the survey team saved them.
return pd.DataFrame({
    "photo_id": ["P-0001", "P-0002", "P-0003", "P-0004"],
    "photo": ["photos/2019/0001.jpg", "photos/2019/0002.jpg", "photos/2023/0001.jpg", "photos/2023/0002.jpg"],
    "year": [2019, 2019, 2023, 2023],
})
nodes.goal: Return the survey photos: photo_id (object), photo (object: local file paths such as photos/2019/0001.jpg), year (int64).
